scope: Independent HD-2D motion/scene rewrite; Original and Storybook preserved
fixes: Action-local phase and continuous roots from sparse source keys; distance-based eight-pose gaits.
Facing hysteresis and stationary contact anchors prevent bbox-driven mirroring/jitter.
Explicit mixed-sheet roles; body/head/arm and boat/hull parts coalesce into complete replacement actors.
Crew share interpolated vessel roots; perspective scaling is smoothed; sharks and composite props are resolved once.
New-world palm, fire, shore and airborne dive contacts; scorecards and dream-bubble placement.
Warmup, coconut, bird and octopus poses; flat lying and seated reactions no longer retain a standing pose.

simulation.visual_method: Sequential comparison contact sheets for scenes, targeted action sequences and dense gait samples; native captures. Videos and per-frame telemetry retained. This is not a claim of a frame-by-frame human viewing of every video.

limitations: The 232 complete poses/cycle frames reinterpret 2391 source frame/layer variations; this is not a one-for-one redraw of all original gestures.
The supplied ultrawide island paintings have visible joins/edge streaks in their outer extensions. These remain artwork cleanup, independent of sprite motion and clipping.
CPU/SDL2 composition and postprocessing, not a 3D or GPU shader renderer.
superseded_reason: User rejected scenario semantics. Motion stability did not prove coherent action, prop interactions or complete stories. Follow evidence/hd2d-story-audit.json.
